propositions: Automated bug filers (heartbeat-alert, binding-drift-alert, conflict-filer) lack dedup logic and file duplicates on flakes or repeated failures.

Heartbeat filer must implement 2-consecutive-red threshold via workflow run-history query (gh api) to suppress single-flake tickets; binding-drift filer skips threshold because drift is persistent state, not self-healing.

All three filers must use stable dedup tags (searchable via has-tag), templated bug bodies with required fields (check name, first-red time, run URL, detail), and abort-if-empty validation with detected_by stamping.
Accumulation comments (max one per 24h) must be dedup'd by marker-line in target ticket's comment history, with no new external state store; workflow run history is the durable state.

Conflict filer must extract from applier.py to conflict_bug_filing.py with per-conflict sha1 dedup tag and no auto-close (adjudication required); heartbeat and binding-drift filers retain existing auto-close on green.

Bug-creation contract documentation must specify exact rebar create args, exit codes, dedup search commands, and REBAR_DETECTED_BY env var for all future auto-filers; audit table enumerates all three existing sites with per-site pattern elements and rationale.
